title: Girl Holding Puppy in Woods with Brother, 1950 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor black-and-white snapshot showing a young girl standing in a wooded area with bare trees, carefully holding a small black and white puppy against her chest. In the bottom right foreground, the head of a younger child is partially visible looking toward the camera. The reverse features a circular photo developer stamp dated March 8, 1950, capturing a tender moment of mid-century American childhood.
